list.text: My big sister says Contests were huge a few years ago, but now the hottest thing are the Double Battle Tournaments!
The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction.
The air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.
I need a partner for the Doubles tournament here.
Verdanturf Town.

\f[faceDiane]\rOlá.
\f[faceDiane]\rVi que vocês estão vindo de outra cidade e gostaria de perguntar se, por acaso não ouviram falar sobre o Butler em algum lugar...
\f[faceDiane]\rEstou procurando por ele.\nEle sumiu fazem alguns dias, parecia estar atrás de algo...
\f[faceButler]\bDiane!
\f[faceDiane]\rButler!
\f[faceDiane]\rEstava atrás de você!
\f[faceButler]\bEu acho que encontrei!\nEncontrei!
\f[faceButler]\bVenha comigo!
\f[faceDiane]\rErr...Desculpe o incômodo.\nPodem esquecer  o que falei. Hehe
\f[faceDiane]\rTchau!
\f[facemay]\rHey! There you are \PN!
\f[facemay]\rYour timing couldn't be better!
\f[facemay]\rHave you seen the Battle Tent yet?
\f[facemay]\rIt's the newest craze in Hoenn!\nThese days, Double Battle Tournaments are all anyone can talk about!
\f[facemay]\rYou team up with another Trainer and battle against another team of two Trainers.
\f[facemay]\rThere are Battle Tents in three cities across Hoenn, and one of them is located here at Verdanturf Town.
\f[facemay]\rIt takes a lot more coordination than you'd think.\nThe matches are even broadcast on TV!
\f[facemay]\rThe prizes are pretty great too.\nYou should give it a try if you get the chance.
\f[facemay]\rAnyway, I've got to get going. See you around!
